name: 73064 · Mustang, OK
findings: ZIP 73064 (Mustang) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 73064 (Mustang) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 73064 (Mustang) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 39% of the typical level).
